title: 3D Ludo Royale
shortDescription: A premium cinematic 3D Ludo experience with local bots, private rooms, and public matchmaking.
longDescription: 3D Ludo Royale is an Ivory Royale board-game classic powered by MH HORIZON. Play instantly with local multiplayer, solo bot matches, mixed Human/Bot seats, private Socket.IO rooms, or public matchmaking. Online rooms are temporary, no-account, no-database matches hosted by the realtime Node server.
onlineRequirement: Online private rooms and public matchmaking require the Socket.IO server. Local modes work without the server.
accountRequirement: No account required. Guest sessions are temporary and stored locally.
dataPersistence: No database. Rooms, queues, rematch votes, and online match state disappear when the server restarts.
controls: Click or tap Roll Dice on your turn.
Click or tap highlighted tokens to move.
Drag the board to orbit the camera.
Use the menu for settings, help, and leaving a match.
mobileSupport: Desktop-first with responsive mobile and tablet controls. Landscape is recommended for the clearest 3D board view.
